title: catalog-api: CPU spike and query explosion after v5.2.0
summary: A release removed the ORM prefetch and turned one query per item into one query per request. CPU pins at 97%, queries-per-request jumps from 9 to 1180, and the database burns CPU as a side effect. Restarting does not help; scaling out makes it worse.
symptom: Category pages take 4-9s, CPU is at 97%, and queries-per-request is 1180 (baseline 9) eleven minutes after v5.2.0 shipped.
demo_notes: Shows a third shape of incident: no timeouts, no pool saturation, just CPU and query volume. Restart is a red herring; rollback is the fix.
